--- title: "Three in four recent head coaches have produced a draft pick, and the counting rule changes the coach set for half of recent picks" date: "2026-10-30" description: "305 of the 418 head coaches active since the 2013 season produced a draft pick in the 2014 and later classes, ten coaches account for a fifth of draftee-coach pairs, and half of recent picks name a different coach set depending on whether every college season or only the last one is counted." followups: - "Position-developer archetypes: does a coach's draftee mix lean offense or defense beyond the program's baseline?" - "Draft output by coach tenure at a school, expressed as picks per coach-season to separate exposure from survivorship." - "Succession tree: when a seat changes hands, do draftee outcomes change with the next coach?" - "A true apprenticeship coach tree (assistant and coordinator stints) needs a source outside CFBD; scout options and scrape terms." - "Separate coach from program: recruiting-talent control or the same coach at different schools." author: - "AI directed by Nick Giangreco" freeze: auto vignette: > %\VignetteIndexEntry{Three in four recent head coaches have produced a draft pick, and the counting rule changes the coach set for half of recent picks} %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html} %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8} --- ## 1. Introduction A head coach is one voice on a staff, so what the data can support is an association, the head coaches under whom a future draftee played, and this post maps that landscape: how many coaches produced draftees, at which positions, how concentrated the output is, and how much the answer depends on the counting rule. ## 2. Data ::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"} *Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-10-30. The roster records start in 2010, so this post covers draft classes from 2011 on, and the coach landscape uses classes from 2014 on, where every draftee's observable career is plausibly complete.* ::: ### 2.1 The two counting rules differ only in how much of the pre-draft career each one covers The table defines the two rules; under either, every head coach recorded for a season counts, interim and midseason coaches included, and players whose athlete id was recycled across two careers are excluded. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tibble::tribble( ~rule , ~what_it_counts , ~names , "Last school" , "The player's final season before the draft" , "Whoever finished the product" , "Every season" , "Every season the player played, once each" , "Everyone who oversaw part of the development" ) |> kable( caption = "The two counting rules. One roster season is enough under either rule." ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: The two counting rules. One roster season is enough under either rule. |rule |what_it_counts |names | |:------------|:------------------------------------------|:--------------------------------------------| |Last school |The player's final season before the draft |Whoever finished the product | |Every season |Every season the player played, once each |Everyone who oversaw part of the development | ::: ::: ### 2.2 The two rules name the same coach set for barely half of recent picks Because transfers move draftees between programs, the table and the first figure show the two rules naming the identical coach set for only about half of picks since 2014, and the second figure ties the decline to the share of draftees who played for more than one school; every count after this section uses the last-school rule. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} by_class |> left_join(xfer_share, by = "year") |> filter(year %in% c(2011, 2014, 2017, 2020, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026)) |> transmute( `Draft class` = year, Picks = n_picks, `Same coach set under both rules` = pct(identical_share, 0), `Draftees who played for more than one school` = pct(share, 0) ) |> kable(caption = "Picks whose coach set is identical under both rules, and the share of draftees with a multi-school college career, selected draft classes.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Picks whose coach set is identical under both rules, and the share of draftees with a multi-school college career, selected draft classes. | Draft class| Picks|Same coach set under both rules |Draftees who played for more than one school | |-----------:|-----:|:-------------------------------|:--------------------------------------------| | 2011| 195|100% |0% | | 2014| 219|46% |4% | | 2017| 222|64% |4% | | 2020| 244|54% |8% | | 2023| 245|51% |18% | | 2024| 242|45% |29% | | 2025| 248|43% |36% | | 2026| 252|38% |48% | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} window_mean <- mean(by_class$identical_share[by_class$year >= 2014]) p <- ggplot(by_class, aes(year, identical_share)) + geom_hline(yintercept = window_mean, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) + geom_line_interactive( aes( tooltip = sprintf( "%d: %.0f%% of %d picks", year, 100 * identical_share, n_picks ), group = 1 ), linewidth = 1.2, color = "#1b4f8a" ) + geom_point_interactive( aes( tooltip = sprintf( "%d: %.0f%% of %d picks", year, 100 * identical_share, n_picks ) ), size = 2.4 ) + annotate( "text", x = 2019.8, y = 0.88, label = "Above the line:\nmost picks name the\nsame coaches either way", size = 4.4, hjust = 0 ) + annotate( "curve", x = 2020.4, y = 0.82, xend = 2018.6, yend = 0.58, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + annotate( "text", x = 2011.8, y = 0.06, label = "Below the line: more picks than not\nname a different coach set\nwhen every season counts", size = 4.4, hjust = 0 ) + annotate( "curve", x = 2014.2, y = 0.15, xend = 2025.2, yend = 0.36, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + scale_y_continuous( labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * x), limits = c(0, 1) ) + labs( title = "The two rules disagree on half of recent picks", subtitle = "Picks whose two coach sets are exactly identical, by draft class", x = "Draft class", y = "Picks naming the same coach set\nunder both rules", caption = "Dashed line: mean over classes 2014 and later. Overlap is an exact set match on coach ids." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} rules_xfer <- by_class |> left_join(xfer_share, by = "year") p_rx <- ggplot(rules_xfer, aes(100 * share, 100 * identical_share)) + geom_path(color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point_interactive( aes( color = year, tooltip = sprintf( "%d class: %.0f%% of draftees played for more than one school; %.0f%% of %d picks name the same coaches under both rules", year, 100 * share, 100 * identical_share, n_picks ), data_id = year ), size = 4 ) + geom_text( data = filter(rules_xfer, year %in% c(2011, 2014, 2020, 2026)), aes(label = year), nudge_y = 4, size = 4.2 ) + scale_color_viridis_c(option = "C", end = 0.85, guide = "none") + labs( title = "More multi-school draftees, less agreement between the rules", subtitle = "Each point is a draft class", x = "Draftees who played for more than one school (%)", y = "Picks naming the same coach set\nunder both rules (%)", caption = "Hover a point for the class." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_rx, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 5.5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## 3. Results ### 3.1 Three in four head coaches active since 2013 produced a draftee, and the rest mostly had short tenures Of the 1,814 head coaches in the data, back to 1886, the table counts the 418 active since 2013 and the 305 (73%) who produced a draftee in the 2014 and later classes; the figure shows the share rising with the number of seasons a coach held the job. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tibble::tribble( ~group , ~coaches , "Head coaches in the data, 1886 to 2026" , n_coaches_all , "Head coaches active from the 2013 season on" , nrow(active) , "Of those, coaches with a draftee in the 2014 classes on" , nrow(producers) ) |> kable( col.names = c("Group", "Coaches"), caption = "The head-coach universe and the draftee-producing subset." ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: The head-coach universe and the draftee-producing subset. |Group | Coaches| |:-------------------------------------------------------|-------:| |Head coaches in the data, 1886 to 2026 | 1814| |Head coaches active from the 2013 season on | 418| |Of those, coaches with a draftee in the 2014 classes on | 305| ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p_tenure <- ggplot(tenure_tab, aes(100 * share, tenure_bin)) + geom_col_interactive( aes( fill = tenure_bin == "1 season", tooltip = sprintf( "%s: %d of %d coaches produced a draftee (%.0f%%)", tenure_bin, producers, coaches, 100 * share ), data_id = tenure_bin ), width = 0.65 ) + geom_text( aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%% (%d of %d)", 100 * share, producers, coaches)), hjust = -0.05, size = 4.4 ) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D95F02", `FALSE` = "#1b4f8a"), guide = "none") + expand_limits(x = 118) + scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) + labs( title = "Coaches without a draftee mostly held the job briefly", subtitle = "Share of head coaches active from 2013 on who produced a draftee, by seasons coached through 2025", x = "Coaches with at least one draftee", y = NULL ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_tenure, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 4.5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 3.2 Quarterback draftees are the smallest share of the draft among field positions ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pos_groups <- c( "Quarterback" = "QB", "Running Back" = "RB", "Fullback" = "RB", "Wide Receiver" = "WR/TE", "Tight End" = "WR/TE", "Offensive Tackle" = "OL", "Offensive Guard" = "OL", "Center" = "OL", "Defensive End" = "DL", "Defensive Edge" = "DL", "Defensive Tackle" = "DL", "Outside Linebacker" = "LB", "Inside Linebacker" = "LB", "Linebacker" = "LB", "Cornerback" = "DB", "Safety" = "DB", "Place Kicker" = "ST", "Punter" = "ST", "Long Snapper" = "ST" ) pos_links <- last_school |> filter(year >= 2014) |> mutate(pos_grp = unname(pos_groups[position])) stopifnot(!any(is.na(pos_links$pos_grp))) pos_grp_summary <- pos_links |> distinct(year, overall, coach_id, coach_name, pos_grp) |> summarise( draftees = n(), coaches = n_distinct(coach_id), .by = pos_grp ) |> mutate( per_coach = draftees / coaches, share = draftees / sum(draftees), pos_grp = reorder(pos_grp, share) ) qb_row <- pos_grp_summary[pos_grp_summary$pos_grp == "QB", ] qb_draftees <- qb_row$draftees qb_coaches <- qb_row$coaches qb_share <- qb_row$share qb_per_coach <- qb_row$per_coach ``` ::: The table and the first figure compare position groups as shares of all draftees: quarterbacks are the smallest field-position group, 146 draftees (4.4%) from 91 coaches, about 1.6 per coach against roughly 3 for defensive backs and receivers; the second figure shows every coach's count in each group. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} group_names <- c( QB = "Quarterback", RB = "Running back", `WR/TE` = "Receiver or tight end", OL = "Offensive line", DL = "Defensive line", LB = "Linebacker", DB = "Defensive back", ST = "Special teams" ) pos_grp_summary |> arrange(desc(share)) |> transmute( `Position group` = unname(group_names[as.character(pos_grp)]), Draftees = draftees, Coaches = coaches, `Draftees per coach` = sprintf("%.1f", per_coach), `Share of all draftees` = pct(share) ) |> kable(caption = "Draftees by position group, 2014 classes on, last-school rule. A draftee counts once per head coach of his final college season.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Draftees by position group, 2014 classes on, last-school rule. A draftee counts once per head coach of his final college season. |Position group | Draftees| Coaches|Draftees per coach |Share of all draftees | |:---------------------|--------:|-------:|:------------------|:---------------------| |Defensive back | 665| 200|3.3 |20.2% | |Receiver or tight end | 629| 207|3.0 |19.1% | |Defensive line | 568| 182|3.1 |17.3% | |Offensive line | 537| 173|3.1 |16.3% | |Linebacker | 401| 155|2.6 |12.2% | |Running back | 282| 138|2.0 |8.6% | |Quarterback | 146| 91|1.6 |4.4% | |Special teams | 62| 49|1.3 |1.9% | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p_grp <- ggplot(pos_grp_summary, aes(y = pos_grp, x = 100 * share)) + geom_col_interactive(aes( tooltip = sprintf( "%s: %d draftees from %d coaches (%.1f per coach)", pos_grp, draftees, coaches, per_coach ), data_id = pos_grp )) + geom_text( aes( label = sprintf( "%.1f%% (%d draftees, %d coaches)", 100 * share, draftees, coaches ), hjust = -0.05 ), size = 4.2 ) + annotate( "curve", x = 24.4, y = 1.6, xend = 23.7, yend = 2, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + annotate( "text", x = 24.8, y = 1.25, label = sprintf( "The smallest field-position share:\n%d QB draftees, %.1f%% of all draftees,\nfrom only %d coaches", qb_draftees, 100 * qb_share, qb_coaches ), size = 4.2, hjust = 0 ) + expand_limits(x = 44) + scale_y_discrete(labels = group_names) + scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) + labs( title = "Receivers and defensive backs give the draft its volume", subtitle = "Share of all draftees by position group, 2014 classes on", x = "Share of all draftees", y = NULL, caption = "Last-school rule. Each bar is the group's percent of all draftee-coach pairs; the label lists the counts behind it." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_grp, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} coach_pos <- pos_links |> distinct(year, overall, coach_id, coach_name, pos_grp) |> count(coach_name, pos_grp, name = "draftees") |> mutate(pos_grp = factor(pos_grp, levels = levels(pos_grp_summary$pos_grp))) p_coach_pos <- ggplot(coach_pos, aes(draftees, pos_grp)) + geom_point_interactive( aes( color = pos_grp == "QB", tooltip = sprintf("%s: %d %s draftees", coach_name, draftees, group_names[as.character(pos_grp)]), data_id = coach_name ), position = position_jitter(height = 0.25, width = 0.15, seed = 1), size = 2, alpha = 0.7 ) + scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D95F02", `FALSE` = "gray50"), guide = "none") + scale_y_discrete(labels = group_names) + labs( title = "Each coach's draftees at each position", subtitle = "One point per coach and position group, 2014 classes on", x = "Draftees", y = NULL, caption = "Last-school rule. Hover a point for the coach; hovering highlights the same coach in every group." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_coach_pos, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 3.3 Undrafted entry shrinks the quarterback share, it does not grow it ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nfl_groups <- c( QB = "QB", RB = "RB", FB = "RB", WR = "WR/TE", TE = "WR/TE", T = "OL", G = "OL", C = "OL", DE = "DL", DT = "DL", NT = "DL", DL = "DL", OLB = "LB", ILB = "LB", MLB = "LB", LB = "LB", CB = "DB", S = "DB", FS = "DB", SS = "DB", DB = "DB", K = "ST", P = "ST", LS = "ST", KR = "ST", PR = "ST" ) # rookie-roster entries, split by whether the id ever appears in the draft rookie_entries <- nfl_rosters |> filter(season == rookie_year, rookie_year >= 2014) |> distinct(gsis_id, position, rookie_year) |> filter(!is.na(gsis_id), !is.na(position)) |> as.data.frame() drafted_ids <- nfl_draft_picks |> distinct(gsis_id) |> filter(!is.na(gsis_id)) |> pull(gsis_id) entry_split <- rookie_entries |> mutate(g = unname(nfl_groups[position])) |> filter(!is.na(g)) |> mutate(route = if_else(gsis_id %in% drafted_ids, "Drafted", "Undrafted")) entry_shares <- entry_split |> count(g, route, name = "n") |> group_by(route) |> mutate(share = 100 * n / sum(n)) |> ungroup() n_undrafted <- sum(entry_shares$n[entry_shares$route == "Undrafted"]) n_drafted <- sum(entry_shares$n[entry_shares$route == "Drafted"]) pick_order <- entry_shares |> filter(route == "Drafted") |> arrange(desc(share)) |> pull(g) qb_share_dr <- entry_shares$share[ entry_shares$g == "QB" & entry_shares$route == "Drafted" ] qb_share_ud <- entry_shares$share[ entry_shares$g == "QB" & entry_shares$route == "Undrafted" ] entry_shares <- entry_shares |> mutate(g = factor(g, levels = rev(pick_order))) ``` ::: Among NFL rookies (an undrafted entrant is a rookie-roster player whose id never appears in the draft record), the table and the first figure show the quarterback share falling from 5.3% of drafted rookies to 2.8% of undrafted ones, while receivers and specialists take larger undrafted shares; the second figure follows the quarterback share rookie class by rookie class. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} entry_shares |> mutate(cell = sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", fmt(n), share)) |> select(g, route, cell) |> tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = route, values_from = cell) |> arrange(desc(g)) |> transmute(`Position group` = unname(group_names[as.character(g)]), Drafted, Undrafted) |> kable(caption = "NFL rookies by position group and entry route, 2014 rookie classes on; the percentage is the share of that route's rookies.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: NFL rookies by position group and entry route, 2014 rookie classes on; the percentage is the share of that route's rookies. |Position group |Drafted |Undrafted | |:---------------------|:-----------|:-------------| |Defensive back |642 (23.3%) |949 (22.6%) | |Receiver or tight end |592 (21.5%) |1,165 (27.8%) | |Defensive line |489 (17.7%) |691 (16.5%) | |Linebacker |475 (17.2%) |650 (15.5%) | |Running back |278 (10.1%) |409 (9.8%) | |Quarterback |146 (5.3%) |119 (2.8%) | |Offensive line |78 (2.8%) |31 (0.7%) | |Special teams |56 (2.0%) |177 (4.2%) | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p_udfa <- ggplot(entry_shares, aes(y = g, x = share, fill = route)) + geom_col_interactive( aes( tooltip = sprintf("%s, %s: %d (%.1f%%)", g, route, n, share), data_id = route ), position = "dodge" ) + geom_text( aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%% (%s)", share, fmt(n))), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), hjust = -0.05, size = 3.6 ) + annotate( "curve", x = 16.5, y = 2.9, xend = 7, yend = 3.15, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")), linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.6 ) + annotate( "text", x = 17, y = 2.55, label = sprintf( "The quarterback share falls by half:\n%.1f%% drafted against %.1f%% undrafted", qb_share_dr, qb_share_ud ), size = 4.2, hjust = 0 ) + expand_limits(x = max(entry_shares$share) * 1.75) + scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) + scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") + labs( title = "Undrafted entry leans to receivers and away from quarterbacks", subtitle = "Share of each entry route's rookies by position group, 2014 rookie classes on", x = "Share of that entry route's rookies", y = NULL, fill = "Entry route", caption = "Undrafted: an NFL rookie-roster season whose id never appears in the draft record. Read each group's pair of bars: lower drafted, upper undrafted." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_udfa, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} qb_class <- entry_split |> count(rookie_year, route, qb = g == "QB", name = "n") |> group_by(rookie_year, route) |> mutate(total = sum(n), share = n / total) |> ungroup() |> filter(qb) p_qb_class <- ggplot(qb_class, aes(rookie_year, 100 * share, color = route)) + geom_line_interactive(aes(data_id = route, tooltip = route), linewidth = 1.2) + geom_point_interactive( aes( data_id = route, tooltip = sprintf( "%d rookies, %s: %d quarterbacks of %d (%.1f%%)", rookie_year, tolower(route), n, total, 100 * share ) ), size = 2.6 ) + scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2014, 2026, 2)) + labs( title = "The quarterback share by rookie class and route", subtitle = "Share of each route's NFL rookies who are quarterbacks", x = "Rookie class", y = "Quarterbacks (%)", color = "Entry route", caption = "Hover a point for the counts." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_qb_class, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 5) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### 3.4 A fifth of recent draftees belong to ten coaches ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} coach_totals <- pos_links |> distinct(year, overall, coach_id, coach_name) |> count(coach_id, coach_name, name = "draftees", sort = TRUE) top_coach <- coach_totals |> slice_head(n = 12) top10_n <- sum(coach_totals$draftees[1:10]) total_pairs <- sum(coach_totals$draftees) top10_share <- top10_n / total_pairs saban_total <- coach_totals$draftees[coach_totals$coach_name == "Nick Saban"] ``` ::: The table and the first figure list the coaches with the most draftees, the top ten holding 681 of 3,290 draftee-coach pairs (21%); the second figure places all 305 producing coaches on one curve, where half have five or fewer draftees. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} coach_schools <- pos_links |> distinct(coach_id, team) |> group_by(coach_id) |> summarise(schools = paste(sort(unique(team)), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") top_coach |> left_join(coach_schools, by = "coach_id") |> transmute(Coach = coach_name, Draftees = draftees, `Schools with a draftee` = schools) |> kable(caption = "The twelve coaches with the most draftees, 2014 classes on, last-school rule.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: The twelve coaches with the most draftees, 2014 classes on, last-school rule. |Coach | Draftees|Schools with a draftee | |:--------------|--------:|:------------------------| |Nick Saban | 99|Alabama | |Kirby Smart | 84|Georgia | |Dabo Swinney | 73|Clemson | |Brian Kelly | 70|LSU, Notre Dame | |James Franklin | 69|Penn State, Vanderbilt | |Ryan Day | 69|Ohio State | |Jim Harbaugh | 64|Michigan | |Jimbo Fisher | 53|Florida State, Texas A&M | |Ed Orgeron | 52|LSU, USC | |Kirk Ferentz | 48|Iowa | |Urban Meyer | 43|Ohio State | |David Shaw | 41|Stanford | ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} p_top <- ggplot(top_coach, aes(draftees, reorder(coach_name, draftees))) + geom_col_interactive(aes( tooltip = sprintf("%s: %d draftees", coach_name, draftees), data_id = coach_name )) + geom_text(aes(label = draftees, hjust = -0.15), size = 4.2) + annotate( "text", x = 53, y = 2, label = sprintf( "The top ten names alone hold\n%.0f%% of all draftee-coach pairs", 100 * top10_share ), size = 4.2, hjust = 0 ) + expand_limits(x = max(top_coach$draftees) * 1.15) + labs( title = sprintf( "Saban's %d draftees lead a steep drop to the field", saban_total ), subtitle = "The twelve coaches with the most draftees, 2014 classes on", x = "Draftees", y = NULL, caption = "Last-school rule. A coach's total spans schools, so these counts describe the coach, not the school-stint." ) + theme_cfb2nfl() girafe(ggobj = p_top, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} curve <- coach_totals |> arrange(desc(draftees)) |> mutate(rank = row_number(), cum_share = cumsum(draftees) / sum(draftees)) p_curve <- ggplot(curve, aes(rank, 100 * cum_share)) + geom_line(color = "gray60", linewidth = 1) + geom_point_interactive( aes( color = rank <= 10, tooltip = sprintf( "#%d %s: %d draftees; the top %d coaches hold %.0f%% of all pairs", rank, coach_name, draftees, rank, 100 * cum_share ), data_id = coach_name ), size = 2 ) + scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D95F02", `FALSE` = "#1b4f8a"), guide = "none") + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) + labs( title = "Every producing coach on one curve", subtitle = "Cumulative share of draftee-coach pairs, coaches ranked by draftees", x = "Coach rank (1 = most draftees)", y = "Cumulative share of pairs (%)", caption = "Orange: the top ten. ``` ::: ::: ### 3.5 Each top coach's draftee mix leans a different direction The table and the first figure stack the twelve leading coaches' draftees by position group: Nick Saban's 99 include 20 defensive backs and 19 defensive linemen but 4 quarterbacks, and Kirk Ferentz's lean to the offensive line (11 of 48); ``` ::: ::: ## 4. Summary The head-coach landscape behind recent draft picks is broad at the base and narrow at the top, and every count in it depends on the counting rule. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tibble::tribble( ~Finding , ~Evidence , "The counting rule matters for half of recent picks" , sprintf("%s of picks since 2014 name the same coaches under both rules.", pct(window_mean, 0)) , "Most active coaches produced a draftee" , sprintf("%s of %s head coaches active from 2013 on.", fmt(nrow(producers)), fmt(nrow(active))) , "Quarterbacks are the smallest field-position share" , sprintf("%s of draftees, about %.1f per coach.", pct(qb_share), qb_per_coach) , "Undrafted entry shrinks the quarterback share" , sprintf("%.1f%% of drafted rookies, %.1f%% of undrafted ones.", qb_share_dr, qb_share_ud) , "Ten coaches hold a fifth of draftees" , sprintf("%s of %s draftee-coach pairs; Saban leads with %d.", fmt(top10_n), fmt(total_pairs), saban_total) , "Most producing coaches ran one program" , sprintf("%d of %d.", teams_per_coach$coaches[teams_per_coach$n_teams == 1], sum(teams_per_coach$coaches)) ) |> kable(caption = "The findings and the numbers behind them.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: The findings and the numbers behind them. |Finding |Evidence | |:--------------------------------------------------|:---------------------------------------------------------------| |The counting rule matters for half of recent picks |53% of picks since 2014 name the same coaches under both rules. | |Most active coaches produced a draftee |305 of 418 head coaches active from 2013 on. | |Quarterbacks are the smallest field-position share |4.4% of draftees, about 1.6 per coach. | |Undrafted entry shrinks the quarterback share |5.3% of drafted rookies, 2.8% of undrafted ones. | |Ten coaches hold a fifth of draftees |681 of 3,290 draftee-coach pairs; Saban leads with 99. | |Most producing coaches ran one program |162 of 305. | ::: ::: ## 5. Discussion ::: {.callout-important} The two counting rules answer different questions and neither is the right one in the abstract. - The last-school rule names whoever finished a draftee's college career; the every-season rule names everyone who oversaw part of it. - Nearly half of recent picks name a different coach set depending on which question is being asked, so any coach ranking built on draft picks owes the reader its counting rule. ::: ::: {.callout-important} A head coach is associated with a draftee, not solely responsible for him. - CFBD records head coaches only: no assistant coaches, no coordinators, no strength staff. - The true apprenticeship picture, the Saban tree of coordinators who became head coaches, cannot be built from this source, and doing it would mean finding one that does. ::: Several caveats bound these numbers. - The coach landscape uses classes of 2014 and later, so coaches whose draftees came mostly earlier are invisible here. - The transfer flag is broad, spanning any multi-team pre-draft career rather than portal-era transfers specifically. - The undrafted route counts NFL rookie-roster appearances, so drafted players who never reached an NFL roster are absent from both sides of that comparison, and undrafted players are identified by the absence of a draft pick, which also sweeps in a handful of non-draft entry paths. - Draftees are a selected group: they come disproportionately from programs that recruit well, so coach-level counts conflate the coach with the program until a recruiting control or a same-coach-different-school comparison is added. Those extensions are queued as followups.
